title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
original_title: The Double Life of My Billionaire Husband
synopsis: Sebastian Klein, dismissed as a loser and ex-con, marries Natalie Quinn, who does not know he is actually a secret billionaire. She must learn the truth, and why he is hiding his identity in the first place.
aliases: en:Double Life of a Billionaire Husband

title: Fated to My Forbidden Alpha
synopsis: On her 18th birthday, Selene learns her mate is her nemesis, Alpha Jackson, who plans to reject her. He does not know she is not an ordinary wolf but a kidnapped Luna, and as she plans to escape, she meets Alexander, her fated mate.

title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
original_title: Never Divorce a Secret Billionaire Heiress
synopsis: After three years married to Tristan Beckett, during which she served as his walking blood bank, Joyce Powell finally divorces him. Tristan thought she married him for money, not knowing she is a secret billionaire heiress, and must try to win her back or lose her to William Pope.

title: Fatal Temptation: Between Two Alphas
synopsis: Mia's life as future Luna is perfect until a witch announces herself as the Alpha's mate. Betrayed, penniless, packless and pregnant, Mia encounters another Alpha who claims to be her one true love, and must decide whether she is his love or a pawn in a dangerous game.

title: True Luna: The White Wolf's Mate
original_title: True Luna: The White Wolf's Mate
synopsis: When Emma Parker turns 18, she discovers her fated mate is Logan Carter, the alpha of her pack, but he rejects her for another she-wolf. Soon after, Emma learns she is no ordinary wolf and that many dangerous people are after her, leaving Logan to risk everything to keep her safe.

title: Snatched From My Wedding by My Ex's Daddy
original_title: Snatched From My Wedding by My Ex's Daddy
synopsis: Following a devastating betrayal and public humiliation on her wedding day, the jilted bride Julia is forcefully taken away by Adrian, the powerful and influential father of her unfaithful fiancé Ethan. Unexpectedly, she finds herself falling in love with this ruthless General, who is willing to go to war with the entire empire just to protect her.

title: My Secret Billionaire Husband
synopsis: Blind Ella marries the comatose Leon out of gratitude, but after he awakens, he conceals his identity as the president of the N Group and poses as an ordinary man to live with her. Ella joins her own company as a physical therapist, where she constantly faces harassment from Martha, as well as scheming from her greedy relatives, the Evans couple. Throughout it all, Leon secretly protects his wife from behind the scenes.

title: Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy
original_title: Bound by Vendetta: Sleeping with the Enemy
synopsis: Daiana thought Enzo was the love of her life until he murdered her entire family. Captured by the enemy, Daiana would have to face the consequences of hatred, find the impossible strength for forgiveness, and experience the cruel side of love.

title: Love The Way You Lie
synopsis: A woman who loses her boyfriend and inheritance to her sister sets out to reclaim what is hers.
cast: Grace Woods Swanson:Molly Johnson|Myles Clohessy:Adrian Mancini|Maxwell David Marcus:Connor Lowe

title: When Forever Fell Apart
synopsis: Devoted wife Natalie Hayes discovers her husband Ethan secretly fathered a child with his ex, Brianna. After repeated betrayals, Natalie leaves him and finds a second chance with her childhood friend Zack Clark.
cast: Samantha Drews:Natalie Hayes|Ryan Jacobucci:Ethan Hayes|EmilyRose Morris:Brianna Hale|Volodymyr Pielikh:Zack Clark

title: The Return of My Drama Queen
original_title: The Return of My Drama Queen
synopsis: On the eve of her execution, Marie Antoinette wishes for a second chance and wakes up in the modern day as failed actress Antonia Lavigne Fontaine, where she gets another shot at her marriage and at a love that endures, if her old villains do not kill her first.

title: Replace the Mafia Heiress? Not A Chance!
original_title: Replace the Mafia Heiress? Not A Chance!
synopsis: Mafia matriarch Ottavia Serra finds the daughter she lost 18 years ago, Zella, but in her previous life the polished stand-in Celia stole Zella's place and left her to die unloved. Given another chance, Ottavia will choose her daughter every time.

title: The Ninth Time I Lost My Memory, I Chose His Best Friend
original_title: The Ninth Time I Lost My Memory, I Chose His Best Friend
synopsis: For three years Celine's recurring amnesia let her boyfriend Ethan replace himself with eight different friends while he stayed with his pregnant mistress. But Celine recovered two years ago, and when Damian Sinclair becomes her ninth fake boyfriend, she turns Ethan's cruel game against him.
aliases: en:The Ninth Time I Lost My Memory

title: The Underworld Heir Never Overthinks
synopsis: Nick DeLuca, raised by a mafia don, returns to his billionaire birth parents, who give him a dusty closet while their adopted favourite lives in luxury. So Nick buys the estate next door, and his adoptive mother arrives as the family's biggest creditor.

title: We Bought Mommy's Ex to Be Our Dad
original_title: We Bought Mommy's Ex to Be Our Dad
synopsis: When Elodie falls into a coma, her twins use their piggy bank to buy a dad. Their choice is Cassian Moretti, a ruthless mafia boss—and Elodie's ex, who has hated her for five years. A familiar necklace and hidden records expose the lies that tore them apart. The twins may be his, and Elodie may have sacrificed everything for him. But when a jealous rival sets the hospital ablaze, Cassian must risk his life to save a woman he never stopped loving—and the family he never knew he had.
